pages.title: Burn Calcite
pages.text: Smelt one Calcite for 180 ticks into two Lime. Combine one Lime, one Sand, and a Water Clay Bucket for four Plaster; the vessel returns through its crafting remainder.

pages.title: Build and Reclaim
pages.text: Four Plaster form one Plaster Block. Craft the block back into four Plaster. This reversible building-material loop needs no powered processing machine.
